name: client-remove-not-owner-403
description: Only the owner, or a holder of session.terminate, may remove an attached client (C1 decision 2, Contract §10 `kill clients`): a second principal that can see the session but is neither is refused 403 forbidden, as DELETE /sessions/{id} is. Authorization is checked before the client_id, so a peer's attempt on any client_id is refused. Needs a second principal whose policy.yaml entry can see the target but lacks session.terminate (inputs peer_user, peer_password).
